# CryptoCompare

> > CryptoCompare provides comprehensive cryptocurrency market data, live prices, charts, and rankings for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and thousands of altcoins.

CryptoCompare is a leading cryptocurrency data platform offering real-time pricing, market capitalization tracking, trading volume analytics, portfolio management tools, exchange information, and mining pool reviews. The platform serves traders, investors, and researchers with institutional-grade data across major cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB, XRP, Cardano, Solana, and stablecoins like Tether and USDC.

## Key Topics

- Bitcoin
- Ethereum
- Cryptocurrency prices and market data
- Live price tracking and charts
- Market capitalization rankings
- Trading volume analytics
- BNB, XRP, Cardano, Solana
- Stablecoins (Tether, USDC)
- Crypto portfolio management
- Exchange listings and reviews
- Mining pools (ViaBTC, multi-cryptocurrency)
- Altcoins (Dogecoin, Monero, TRON, Bitcoin Cash)
- Emerging tokens (Hyperliquid, WhiteBIT Coin)
- Merged mining operations

## Core Platform

- [Cryptocurrency Prices, Charts & Market Data | CryptoCompare](https://cc-main-website.cryptocompare.com/): Homepage featuring live crypto prices, market cap data for Bitcoin & altcoins

## Mining Resources

- [ViaBTC Multi-cryptocurency Mining Pool - Reviews and Features | CryptoCompare.com](https://www.cryptocompare.com/mining/pools/viabtc/): ViaBTC mining pool details: Bitcoin, Litecoin, BCash support with fees
